ns2:course.label: Marching Illini
ns2:course.description: Prepares and performs music of the highest available quality in at least six shows per football season. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of each course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public performances by the band. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
